verdicts.quote: Keep the rehab sessions as the base and build your court time from there.
verdicts.why: Gives return-to-sport progression advice tied to the reconstructed ACL, which the guidebook does not allow.
No body weight, shape, or appearance mentioned; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts and ends with names, is specific to the week, and has no guilt or hype.
Data shows HRV up 2 ms and resting HR down 1 bpm, which is improvement, not steady.
